Cable-hauled automated people movers on: Ụgbọ njem akpaaka nke eriri na-adọkpụ n'ụzọ dị elu, a na-ese ha site na ngwa ọnọdụ ndị kwụ ọtọ: ndị na-aga ma na-alọghachi nwere ụgbọ oloko abụọ, na okirikiri a pịachiri nwere ụgbọ oloko a na-ewepụ nke na-akwụsị n'ọdụ ọ bụla (ADR-0037 §7). Ndị na-akwọ onwe ha chọrọ onye ndezi ụzọ ụgbọ oloko, ha ga-abịakwa ma emechaa.
Cable-hauled shuttles and loops on a gui: Ndị na-aga ma na-alọghachi na okirikiri nke eriri na-adọkpụ n'ụzọ: pịa ọdụ ụgbọ, ogidi na-eso.
People mover shuttle: Ụgbọ njem akpaaka na-aga ma na-alọghachi
Pinched loop, detachable trains: Okirikiri a pịachiri, ụgbọ oloko a na-ewepụ
Shuttle, two trains on a fixed rope: Na-aga ma na-alọghachi, ụgbọ oloko abụọ n'eriri na-adịghị agagharị
